spend.exchangeRatePolicy: Must be supplied explicitly at execution time; never hard-code a live FX rate.

preferred.reason: Exact model ID, serverless billing, native image input and function calling without a dedicated multi-GPU commitment.

safetyControls: free-quota-only switch for eligible new international accounts

freeQuota.eligibility: New international Model Studio users only; console verification required

pricing.reason: Published pricing is region and input-length tier dependent; do not copy a different region or currency into the runtime.

alternatives.reason: Dedicated inference is vastly more expensive than serverless inference and still does not provide a fine-tuning run by itself.

workloadSeparation.serverlessInference: Preferred for PWA text, image, tools and exact-model evaluation.
workloadSeparation.dedicatedInference: Rejected until measured serverless demand justifies reserved throughput.
workloadSeparation.loraOrQloraTraining: Requires a provider that explicitly exposes training or a distributed GPU cluster capable of loading the open weights, optimizer state, checkpoints and resume storage.
workloadSeparation.continuedPretraining: Not authorized; substantially larger data and compute requirement than adapter training.
workloadSeparation.qwen3_8bBridge: May validate schemas, scripts, resume and checkpoint plumbing only; cannot represent Qwen 397B quality or memory admission.

nextAction: Supply an explicit monthly MXN ceiling and complete provider account/payment or 2FA. Then estimate a bounded workload, store secrets, enable provider-side alerts/cutoff and run exact-model smoke tests.
